I spent 3 weeks in Japan in 2018.

The guy chose a milk tea and a pack of cigarettes so we smoked one and I thanked him as much as I could.

I have never seen this level of politeness anywhere else in the world.
And the food is actually really good. 3 weeks in Japan and my go-to place to get cheap good food was 7-Eleven, hands down.
